description: Stateless in-memory payment calculation and PDF synthesis returning a new Receipt or partial-payment Invoice JSON + PDF without mutating server records. Example: record_payment({"document":{},"amount_paid":100})

amount_paid.description: Amount paid; defaults to grand total (PAID IN FULL) or computes partial balance due.

document.description: Stateless input invoice JSON payload to compute payment against (returns a new synthesized document without mutating server records).

payment_method.description: Method of payment (e.g., Stripe, Apple Pay, Bank Wire).

name: record_payment

document.description: Newly synthesized receipt or partial-payment invoice JSON.

title: Stateless Payment Receipt & Balance Synthesis
